title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
abstract: arXiv:2610.05533v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison or an evaluation defect. We preregistered two studies of where these gains come from, with three models of 1.7B to 8B parameters and with Qwen3-14B, and report all 65 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 7 of 12 model-benchmark cells, each time mostly through questions the capped setting left without a readable answer. For the small models, the thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration in 7 of 9 cells, nor, for the 1.7B model, than four GEPA-selected harnesses. At 14B, two GEPA harnesses beat it by 30 to 34 points on the LongevityBench letter tasks; in descriptive analyses they were not detectably above the strongest constant-label basel

translated_title: 测试框架修复了什么？一项关于可见性、基线充分性与评估缺陷的预注册研究
translated_abstract: 测试框架搜索会在冻结模型周围保留对提示词、token预算或解析器的更改，只要该更改能提升评测分数。这种提升可能来自解析器此前无法读取的答案、较弱的对比基线或评估缺陷。我们预注册了两项关于这些提升来源的研究，使用三个参数量从1.7B到8B的模型以及Qwen3-14B，并报告了全部65个主要终点。在12个模型-基准组合中的7个里，关闭思考模式比受限思考设置获得了更高的准确率，且每次提升主要来自那些在受限思考设置下没有可读答案的问题。对于小模型，关闭思考的设置在9个组合中的7个里并不显著劣于救援配置，对于1.7B模型，也不劣于四个通过GEPA选择的测试框架。在14B规模上，两个GEPA测试框架在LongevityBench字母任务上比它高出30到34分；但在描述性分析中，它们并未显著超过最强的恒定标签基线。
tldr: 本预注册研究通过系统实验发现，测试框架搜索带来的评测分数提升往往源于解析器可见性问题和评估缺陷等伪影而非真实能力增益，且简单的关闭思考设置在多数情况下足以媲美甚至胜过经过搜索优化的框架配置。
en_tdlr: This preregistered study shows that score gains from harness search on LLM benchmarks often stem from parser visibility issues and evaluation defects rather than genuine capability improvements, and a simple thinking-off setting matches or beats searched harness configurations in most cases.
